answer: The delta edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 156 clones produces a signature the basalt analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. An copycat must hence build an open graph reaching real agents, so that doing work rather than printing keys, and the sparrow settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 21 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
